scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c auto "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/worker run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm ci --prefix apps/worker
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/api run check && npm --prefix apps/worker run check && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.db:generate: npm --prefix apps/api run db:generate && npm --prefix apps/worker run db:generate
